fragment_miss_surface_label: Example unresolved fragment-target posture for long official voter-information pages
delivery_role_note: Bounded miss-recovery review surface for same-page official links, copied #fragment references, and section-level jumps that may point nowhere or no longer resolve cleanly.

reviewed_fragment_targets.miss_behavior: A visible inline note identifies that the requested section target is unavailable and places focus on the current in-page navigation summary.
reviewed_fragment_targets.fallback_recovery: Use the top summary or the 'Accepted ID options' entry in the current on-page section list.

reviewed_fragment_targets.miss_behavior: The page displays a current-section replacement cue and a link to the latest deadline notice rather than silently dropping to the top of the page.
reviewed_fragment_targets.fallback_recovery: Follow the latest deadline notice or the official office/help route if the exact subsection is no longer present.

target_resolution_policy_note: Critical same-page targets are reviewed for direct resolution; when direct resolution fails, the route provides truthful miss feedback and bounded refinding help instead of a silent generic shell.
unresolved_target_feedback_note: Miss feedback identifies that the section-level destination could not be found and preserves enough target identity that the reader knows what failed.
refinding_fallback_note: Routes expose a trustworthy current summary, section list, or official fallback notice/help path when the exact target cannot be recovered directly.
top_of_page_summary_recovery_note: Top-of-page recovery cues are reviewed so a missed fragment does not look identical to an ordinary successful page load.
collapsed_or_hidden_target_policy_note: If the intended section now sits behind collapsed, injected, or deferred content, the miss posture either reveals that region or routes to an explicit current replacement path.
current_location_truthfulness_note: Current-location cues are reviewed so the route does not falsely imply that the missing target was actually reached.
